contract.review_scope: Complete captured redacted body; projected expressions/aliases, joins, filters, quantity/status selection, null behavior, grouping and ordering. Opaque literals and external callers remain qualified.
contract.purpose: Return consolidated master bill-of-lading header and a separate container detail result set.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration (literal placeholders are not executable values): CREATE PROCEDURE RPT_MasterBOLConsolHeader( @INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM numeric(9)) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: COUNT DISTINCT ignoresNULL: one real company plusNULL still chooses that company. Multiple companies leaveNULL and warehouse fallback. No matching shipping address leaves destinationNULL; duplicate address/config/carrier rows can multiply output. Container details include every nesting level, not roots alone; no numeric aggregation.

ordered_branches.explanation: Set @company=MIN(company) only when COUNT(DISTINCT company)=1 for load shipments. Header load inner warehouse then left company/address/carrier generic-service joins; ship-from address precedence is warehouse-company then company then warehouse by row presence. Ship-to comes from SHIPPING_ADDRESS at load and opaque record_type. Underlying-BOL helper supplies bol_list. Second SELECT takes ALL containers for load shipments, left shipment detail and NMFC config by record_type/identifier; order_num customer_po else ERP order; nonNULL hazardous_code emits opaque marker. Neither result has ORDER BY.
